note: Grow the edit-song library from legit, redistributable sources only. Prefer phonk, drift phonk, Brazilian phonk, slowed+reverb, and fast-edit beat-drop tracks (no boring NCS-style bed instrumentals, no podcasts, no OST dumps). Sources: Internet Archive CC0/CC-BY/CC-BY-SA, Pixabay Music (free commercial), YouTube Audio Library, Free Music Archive (CC BY/CC0), and phonk artists that allow free commercial use. Each track gets license, credit, and safety=safe|claim_risk. Ingest runs on GitHub Actions (music-ingest.yml).
